g.text: holds Model + Solver refs, GP cache
1. u_loc = T_cached * u_global_48 ← rotate to local
2. u_loc(6:6:end) = [] → per_5_blkdiag() → u_mix ← strip + permute [FIX BUG 1]
3. IF HistoryData valid → READ sigma,eps_p,p directly ← exact [FIX BUG 3]
ELSE integrate with D_el + A_geom correction ← correct [FIX BUG 2]
returns [20×1] gpData: sigma, eps_p, p, von_mises, yielded, ...
maps fieldName → scalar per GP (20 values per element)
LS fit per node patch → evaluate at node
kinematic: direct from U_Hist · stress: GP→SPR
